{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with revenue parsed
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract conversion rate for new customers in email channel
email_new_conversion = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[
    (conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'email') & 
    (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new'),
    'converted'
].iloc[0]

# Extract conversion rate for new customers in paid_search channel
paid_search_new_conversion = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc[
    (conversion_by_channel_segment['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (conversion_by_channel_segment['customer_segment'] == 'new'),
    'converted'
].iloc[0]

# Print the specific values
print(f'Email channel, new customers: {email_new_conversion:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search channel, new customers: {paid_search_new_conversion:.4f}')"}
